metadata.title: Privacy Policy - NailsZone
metadata.description: How NailsZone collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.description: At NailsZone, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, share, and safeguard your personal information when you visit our website, use our services, or interact with us. By using NailsZone, you consent to the data practices described in this policy.

information_we_collect.title: Information We Collect
information_we_collect.personal_identification: Personal Identification Information: We may collect your name, email address, physical address, phone number, and other contact details when you register, make a purchase, or interact with our services.
information_we_collect.payment: Payment Information: For purchases, payment details are processed securely by our payment service providers.
information_we_collect.browsing: Browsing Information: We automatically collect information about your browsing behavior, including your IP address, browser type, and usage patterns.

how_we_use_information.title: How We Use Your Information
how_we_use_information.description: Service Provision: To manage your account, process orders, and deliver services. Communication: To communicate with you about your account or transactions, and to inform you about relevant promotions, updates, or services. Improvement: To improve and personalize your experience on our website.

sharing_of_information.title: Sharing of Information
sharing_of_information.service_providers: Service Providers: We may share your information with third parties that perform services on our behalf, such as payment processing and delivery logistics.
sharing_of_information.legal_requirements: Legal Requirements: We may disclose your information if required by law or if we believe such action is necessary to protect our rights, property, or safety, or that of our users or the public.
sharing_of_information.consent: Consent: We will not share your personal data with other third parties without your explicit consent.

data_protection.title: Data Protection
data_protection.description: Security Measures: We implement a variety of security measures to maintain the safety of your personal information, including encryption and access controls. Compliance: We comply with GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, PIPEDA, and other applicable privacy laws in collecting, using, and protecting your information.

your_rights.title: Your Rights
your_rights.access_correction: Access and Correction: You have the right to access and correct your personal information.
your_rights.deletion: Deletion: You can request the deletion of your personal data under certain conditions.
your_rights.consent_withdrawal: Consent Withdrawal: You have the right to withdraw consent at any time, where relevant.
your_rights.data_portability: Data Portability: You have the right to receive your personal data in a structured, commonly used format.

cookies_and_tracking.title: Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies_and_tracking.description: Our <link>Cookie Policy</link> details how we use cookies and tracking technologies to enhance your experience and gather data about website usage.

international_transfers.title: International Transfers
international_transfers.description: Your information may be transferred to, stored, and processed in a country different from where it was collected, always under strict compliance with applicable laws regarding data protection.

changes.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.description: NailsZone reserves the right to update this Privacy Policy at any time. We will notify you of significant changes and indicate at the top of the policy when it was last updated.

contact_us.title: Contact Us
contact_us.description: For questions about this Privacy Policy or any of our policies, please contact us at <email>teamnz@levincigroup.com</email>.
